text: Captured the pre-edit dirty-tree baseline and historical negative evidence. Reduced offset-column tests reproduced the remaining defect: explicit centered J and JtJ were computed but rejected against the unstable streamed subtraction. Corrected the fallback authority, added stable origin-shifted gradient centering and non-finite checks, and added independent projector, finite-difference, rank-deficient, near-perfect, and low-contrast tests. Focused JVM and Scala.js suites pass 8/8 each.
